例句

  1. I’m so busy doing the housework every day that I have no time to see a movie.
    我每天忙著做家事，忙到沒有時間去看電影。
  2. The box was so heavy that I couldn't lift it.
    那個箱子重到我抬不起來。
  3. It was so cold that the lake froze.
    天氣冷到湖都結冰了。
  4. The music was so loud I couldn't hear you.
    音樂大聲到我聽不到你說話。
  5. My mother is busy cooking dinner.
    我媽媽正忙著煮晚餐。
  6. I was busy with my homework last night.
    我昨晚忙著寫作業。
  7. Tom is busy preparing for the exam.
    Tom 正忙著準備考試。
  8. The students were busy cleaning the classroom.
    學生們正忙著打掃教室。
  9. My father is always busy working.
    我爸爸總是忙著工作。
  10. We were busy packing for our trip to Japan.
    我們正忙著打包去日本旅行的行李。
  11. Ann is busy with club activities this week.
    Ann 這個星期忙著社團活動。
  12. The teachers are busy with the school festival.
    老師們正忙著校慶的事。
  13. I have no time to eat breakfast.
    我沒有時間吃早餐。
  14. Do you have time to talk now?
    你現在有空聊一下嗎？
  15. I don't have time to watch TV on weekdays.
    我平日沒有時間看電視。
  16. She had no time to change her clothes.
    她沒有時間換衣服。
  17. We didn't have time to visit the castle.
    我們沒有時間參觀那座城堡。
  18. I'll have time to read this book during the vacation.
    放假期間我會有時間讀這本書。
  19. My grandparents have a lot of time to travel now.
    我爺爺奶奶現在有很多時間去旅行。
  20. Ann has no time to answer my messages.
    Ann 沒有時間回我的訊息。
  21. He was so busy playing games that he forgot to eat lunch.
    他忙著打電動，忙到忘記吃午餐。
  22. I was so busy studying that I had no time to call you.
    我忙著讀書，忙到沒有時間打電話給你。
  23. My sister is busy taking care of her baby, so she has no time to go out.
    我姊姊忙著照顧她的寶寶，所以她沒有時間出門。
  24. Everyone was busy taking pictures of Mount Fuji.
    每個人都忙著拍富士山的照片。
  25. The farmers are busy with the rice harvest.
    農夫們正忙著收割稻子。
  26. Don't worry. You'll have time to finish it tomorrow.
    別擔心。你明天會有時間把它做完。
  27. My parents are so busy running their shop that they have no time to take a vacation.
    我爸媽忙著經營他們的店，忙到沒有時間去度假。
  28. I had no time to do my hair this morning.
    我今天早上沒有時間弄頭髮。
  29. When I was busy with my report, my friend came to help me.
    我忙著寫報告的時候，我朋友來幫我。
  30. Do you have time to help me with this box?
    你有時間幫我搬這個箱子嗎？
  31. He is busy practicing for the speech contest.
    他正忙著為演講比賽練習。
  32. I was busy with work, so I didn't have time to cook.
    我忙著工作，所以沒有時間煮飯。
  33. Last month I was so busy working part-time that I had no time to get enough sleep.
    上個月我忙著打工，忙到沒有時間睡飽。
  34. The movie was so boring I fell asleep halfway through.
    那部電影無聊到我看到一半就睡著了。
